[[File:Shawn heflick and indian cobra.jpg|thumb|Heflick holding a large [[Indian cobra]]]]
'''Shawn Heflick''' (born June 17, 1969) is an American explorer, herpetologist, and television host.

== Biography ==
Shawn Heflick grew up on his family farm near [[Marion, Ohio]]. He became fascinated with reptiles after exploring in the woods and encountering a [[mating ball]] of [[garter snake]]s. He graduated from [[Wright State University]] in 1993.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Hannah |first=Jim |title=Wright State grad finds fame as python hunter |url=https://webapp2.wright.edu/web1/newsroom/2012/07/03/wright-state-grad-finds-fame-as-python-hunter/ |access-date=2026-08-31 |website=Wright State Newsroom |language=en-US |archive-date=2025-12-10 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251210000026/http://webapp2.wright.edu/web1/newsroom/2012/07/03/wright-state-grad-finds-fame-as-python-hunter/ |url-status=live }}</ref> He is the president of the [[Central Florida Herpetological Society]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=2010-02-19 |title=Invasion of the Giant Pythons ~ Herpetologist Shawn Heflick Answers Your Questions |url=https://www.pbs.org/wnet/nature/invasion-of-the-giant-pythons-herpetologist-shawn-heflick-answers-your-questions/5564/ |access-date=2026-08-31 |website=Nature |language=en-US |archive-date=2024-12-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241216120525/https://www.pbs.org/wnet/nature/invasion-of-the-giant-pythons-herpetologist-shawn-heflick-answers-your-questions/5564/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

While working with the Florida Wildlife and Conservation Commission, Heflick began appearing on the show ''Python Hunters'' on [[Nat Geo Wild]]. In the show, Heflick and his crew travel into the [[Everglades]] to hand-capture [[Burmese python]]s for study.<ref name=":0" /> He also features in an episode of ''[[Nature (TV program)|Nature]]'' titled "Invasion of the Giant Pythons",<ref name=":1" /> as well as the documentary film ''[[Titanoboa: Monster Snake]]''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Titanoboa: Monster Snake - Full Cast & Crew |url=https://www.tvguide.com/movies/titanoboa:-monster-snake/cast/2000295754/ |access-date=2026-08-31 |website=TV Guide |language=en}}</ref>
